product.title: The Best of Rio de Janeiro in a Private Guided Tour

description.text: In Rio de Janeiro, this private 8-hour outing pairs a carioca guide and driver with one group so the day can stay on Christ the Redeemer, Sugar Loaf Mountain, Copacabana and Ipanema beaches, São Bento Monastery, Maracanã Stadium, or the Sambadrome. Hotel pickup and drop-off are included. The guide confirms themes such as food, history, or sport before departure and keeps the published stops limited to sites the group actually wants. Entrance tickets, food, and drinks are listed separately on the product page. The format suits visitors who want undivided attention without joining a coach loop or assembling taxi and ticket timing independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Rio de Janeiro, and the itinerary stays on the granite peaks, South Zone beaches, and carnival landmarks that define this private day rather than a hang-gliding or Petrópolis add-on.

highlights: Private 8-hour circuit tailored around Christ the Redeemer, Sugar Loaf, beaches, or sport landmarks
Dedicated carioca guide and driver for one group
Hotel pickup and drop-off listed on the product page

start.description: Hotel pickup and drop-off are included from the confirmed Rio de Janeiro accommodations listed when booking. The guide contacts the group before departure to confirm the itinerary.

end.description: Return to your Rio de Janeiro meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
